name: WARNING: Terminal Pre-Flight Fast-Food Bacon Burger & Fries
searchKeywords: eating fast food before flying crohns
whyItWorks: Consuming 70g+ of fryer oil, bacon grease, melted cheese, and raw onion rings immediately before boarding a flight delays gastric emptying. In a seated posture for hours under altitude expansion, this induces severe nausea, acid reflux, and sudden gastrocolic urgency.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid greasy fast food at the gate. Eat plain grilled turkey sandwiches, bananas, or eggs.
